    ?euDept uni:belongsTo ?euUniversity .

  }

    ?professor uni:worksIn ?bigDept .

Created `/app/solution.sparql`.

The query:
- Filters full professors with `STRSTARTS(?role, "Professor of")`
- Requires an EU-member department via `FILTER EXISTS`-style subquery with the 27 EU codes as of 2025-08-16
- Requires at least one department with `COUNT(DISTINCT ?student) > 10`, counting students enrolled by 2025-08-16 with no graduation date on/before that date
- Aggregates every country of every department the professor works in

Verified by running it with rdflib against `/app/university_graph.ttl`; output:

```
Orfeas Menis    GR, US
Pepe Attanasio  PT, GR
Aristotle Tympas GR
```

Post-check also confirmed the only departments with >10 current students are `ComputerScience_NTUA` (12), `HistoryAndPhilosophy_NKUA` (12), and `Engineering_Berkeley` (11). Marie Dubois is excluded because Sorbonne has only 6 current students, and assistant professors are excluded by role.
